title: A Hidden Bowl in a Bag Changed Everything

meta.name: v5_y12_12_the-hidden-bowl
meta.title: A Hidden Bowl in a Bag Changed Everything

lines.text: A hidden bowl in a bag changed everything.
So when he had furnished them with their supplies, he put the [gold measuring] bowl into the bag of his brother.

quran.ar: فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمۡ جَعَلَ ٱلسِّقَایَةَ فِی رَحۡلِ أَخِیهِ

lines.text: The brothers sneer: a brother of his stole before.
But Joseph kept it within himself and did not reveal it to them.

quran.ar: فَأَسَرَّهَا یُوسُفُ فِی نَفۡسِهِۦ وَلَمۡ یُبۡدِهَا لَهُمۡۚ

lines.text: We raise in degrees whom We will, but over every possessor of knowledge is one [more] knowing.

quran.ar: فَبَدَأَ بِأَوۡعِیَتِهِمۡ قَبۡلَ وِعَاۤءِ أَخِیهِ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَخۡرَجَهَا مِن وِعَاۤءِ أَخِیهِۚ كَذَ ٰ⁠لِكَ كِدۡنَا لِیُوسُفَۖ مَا كَانَ لِیَأۡخُذَ أَخَاهُ فِی دِینِ ٱلۡمَلِكِ إِلَّاۤ أَن یَشَاۤءَ ٱللَّهُۚ نَرۡفَعُ دَرَجَـٰتࣲ مَّن نَّشَاۤءُۗ وَفَوۡقَ كُلِّ ذِی عِلۡمٍ عَلِیمࣱ

lines.text: Every expert has someone who knows more.
Not every insult needs an answer.
